title: Ashbury Rewards Folio Reconciliation Standard: Welcome On-Property Spend Supplement
content:
**Standard.** The on-property spend of an Ashbury Rewards stay is the breakfast, food and beverage and spa charges on its Guest Folios bill less the adjustments posted against those charges; an on-property spend of three hundred US dollars or more carries a welcome on-property spend supplement of five hundred points, one from one hundred dollars up to but not including three hundred dollars carries two hundred and fifty points, and a lower one carries none. The supplement forms part of the welcome points of the stay; when the tier's welcome amount for the stay is zero, the stay receives no welcome points and carries no supplement.

## What enters the on-property spend

| Folio line | Enters the on-property spend |
|---|---|
| Breakfast, food and beverage and spa incidental charges | Added |
| Adjustments posted against breakfast, food and beverage or spa charges | Subtracted |
| Room, tax, resort fee, minibar, parking and every other line | Not included |

## Bands

| On-property spend | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 300.00 USD or more | 500 points |
| 100.00 USD up to but not including 300.00 USD | 250 points |
| Below 100.00 USD | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical folios)

| Breakfast | Food and beverage | Spa | Adjustments on those lines | On-property spend | Supplement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60.00 | 140.00 | 120.00 | 20.00 | 300.00 | 500 points |
| 60.00 | 140.00 | 120.00 | 20.01 | 299.99 | 250 points |
| 45.00 | 54.99 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 99.99 | None |
